Finite H1 mathematical fixtures. Not measured model quality, biology or causal equivalence.
The small extra bar is never deleted.
5 grid points · 3 retained ranks in fast view
Colors normalized for display; metric is not.
Exact landscapes: all finite ranks and every linear breakpoint. Images and fixed-grid vectors: explicitly approximate.
L2 is not Wasserstein/bottleneck distance. Essential bars, directed paths, chirality and provenance remain separate evidence.
